sources.title: The effects of digestion temperature and temperature shock on the biogas yields from the mesophilic anaerobic digestion of swine manure
sources.review_method: Primary publisher indexed abstract and Feed characteristics section; full page returned HTTP403, no access bypass
reviewed_sections: Abstract: observed ultimate CH4 yields at25/30/35C
Feed characteristics: TS23885 and VS16310 mg/L
limitations: Diluted swine slurry from South Korea; wash-water dilution and refrigerated storage. Not solid manure or a universal slurry composition.
Reported batch endpoint methane yield, not theoretical maximum or prediction by a fixed day.
Yield figures refer to moderate feed loads5-20 percent v/v, not proof that the entire available lot fits one safe reactor charge.
Numerical STP T/P and gas moisture not verified from accessible sections; energy use requires an explicit gas-reference assumption.
Temperature variants are distinct source observations, not a probability interval.

sources.title: Microorganism-regulated mechanisms of temperature effects on the performance of anaerobic digestion
reviewed_sections: Methods: seeded swine slurry, TS8percent, semi-continuous HRT30d
limitations: Distinct seeded semi-continuous experiment; not a calibration of the user reactor or the Chae batch sample.
Qualitative process tradeoffs only; do not multiply a batch BMP by daily methane production or use total biogas as methane.
